emily: quick sync: our py/ts/go snippets for streaming+retries+pagination are out of sync. found a dead anchor on the migration page. can someone assemble a tiny polyglot cookbook we can link from the migration guide?

raj: I can do a compact single doc with language tabs. keep examples < 20 lines each. main goals: show resume token persistence, retry using resume token, and top-level pagination (cursor).

nina: CI note: docs-snippet-check failed on Go due to shared buffer across goroutines. use channel-per-stream and single writer for resume_token.

marcus: here's a minimal Python snippet (short):
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resume_token = None
for chunk in client.stream('gpt-xx', prompt='hi'):
    if chunk.type == 'resume':
        resume_token = chunk.token
    print(chunk.text, end='')
# retry
if resume_token:
    client.stream('gpt-xx', resume_token=resume_token)
```

raj: TypeScript analog (compact):
```ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const c=new Redwood.Client()
let resume_token:string|null=null
for await (const item of c.stream('gpt-xx',{prompt:'hi'})) {
  if (item.type==='resume') resume_token=item.token
  process.stdout.write(item.delta||'')
}
if (resume_token) await c.stream('gpt-xx',{resumeToken:resume_token})
```

nina: Go fix (channel + single writer):
```go
ctx:=context.Background()
client:=redwood.NewClient()
ch:=make(chan string)
var resume string
go func(){defer close(ch); for chunk := range client.Stream(ctx,"gpt-xx",nil).Chunks(){ if chunk.Type==redwood.ResumeChunk{ resume=chunk.Token } ch<-chunk.Text }}()
for t:=range ch{fmt.Print(t)}
if resume!=""{client.Stream(ctx,"gpt-xx",redwood.StreamOpts{ResumeToken:resume})}
```

emily: include a one-line callout: resume tokens are best-effort, may expire (TTL), and do not guarantee exactly-once. update migration page anchor to `#pagination-cursors`.

docs-bot: preview: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/branch/docs/mini-cookbook-resume (auto-refresh).
